definition_used: The paper/abstract/poster was not presented at the conference for which it was accepted.
caution: The reason describes a conference presentation status, not a manuscript integrity issue. It does not directly map to any of the four manuscript-facing categories, which focus on research content, attribution, editorial governance, or post-publication oversight.
semantic_rationale: The definition indicates that the work was not presented as planned, which is a procedural or policy matter (publication_policy_or_sanction) concerning the article's general status, but it does not inherently imply unreliability of research content, authorship/attribution problems, editorial/peer review issues, or post-publication transparency failures.
